theme: 3 terms on repeating code: a loop over items, a loop with a first check and a loop with a last check

terms.definition: A loop that runs its body once for each item in a collection or range.
terms.example: Use a for-in loop to print each name in the `names` array.

terms.definition: A loop that checks a condition first, then runs its body again and again while the condition is true.
terms.example: Use a while loop to count down while `count` is above zero.

terms.definition: A loop that runs its body first, then checks a condition to decide whether to run again.
terms.example: Use a repeat-while loop, so the login code runs at least once.

video.title: For-In, While & Repeat-While Loops in 2 minutes | iOS Daily English Day 21
video.description:
Learn to talk about repeating code in Swift: For-In Loop, While Loop & Repeat-While Loop, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
For-In Loop - A loop that runs its body once for each item in a collection or range.
While Loop - A loop that checks a condition first, then runs its body again and again while the condition is true.
Repeat-While Loop - A loop that runs its body first, then checks a condition to decide whether to run again.

landscape.title: Swift For-In, While & Repeat-While Loops in English | Day 21
landscape.description:
Explain For-In Loop, While Loop & Repeat-While Loop in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
For-In, While, Repeat-While 반복문 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

For-In Loop - A loop that runs its body once for each item in a collection or range.
한국어: For-In 루프: 컬렉션이나 범위의 항목마다 한 번씩 본문을 실행하는 반복문

While Loop - A loop that checks a condition first, then runs its body again and again while the condition is true.
한국어: While 루프: 먼저 조건을 확인하고, 조건이 참인 동안 본문을 계속 실행하는 반복문

Repeat-While Loop - A loop that runs its body first, then checks a condition to decide whether to run again.
한국어: Repeat-While 루프: 본문을 먼저 실행한 뒤 조건을 확인해 다시 실행할지 정하는 반복문

dialogue.title: Loops in a chat

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mina, I need to print every name in `names`. How do I do that?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Use a For-In Loop. Write `for name in names`, and it runs once for each name.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So a For-In Loop visits every item in the array?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. Now I want a countdown. Use a While Loop with `while count > 0`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does a While Loop check the condition before the first run?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, it checks first, so it may run zero times.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What if I need one run for sure?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Use a Repeat-While Loop. It runs the body first, then checks `count < 2`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh, I thought a Repeat-While Loop was the same as a While Loop.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Close, but the check comes after the body, not before.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Got it. A For-In Loop for items, a While Loop for a first check, a Repeat-While Loop for one sure run.
Use a for-in loop to print each name.
